TOWN OF SOUTH KINGSTOWN 
AFFORDABLE HOUSING COLLABORATIVE COMMITTEE 
Meeting Agenda 
Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 7:00 PM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, 2nd Floor Conference Room 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov 
Peter Swain, Chair 
Susan Mittendorf, Vice Chair 
Amy Crawford, Secretary 
Brian Smith 
Nick Furcolo 
Dennis Haggerty 
- Vacant -  
 
Unless otherwise noted, the AHC may discuss and/or act upon each item on this agenda. 
  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 
 1. 9/24/2026 Draft Minutes 
 
C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
 
D. New Business: 
 
 1. Form-Based Code Debrief — Discussion of the public hearings for the Old Tower Hill Road Form-
Based Code and any potential next steps for the Committee.  
 
 2. Housing Forward Roundtable Debrief — Discussion of the recent South County Housing Forward 
Roundtable hosted by the Executive Office of Housing. 
 
E. Old Business: 
 
 1. Affordable Housing Collaborative Website — Discussion of the AHC website, potential edits, and 
connection to the existing SK town website page. Click here for the link. 
 
 2. Waitlist Process for Private Low-to-Moderate Income Housing Options — Discussion of the 
waitlist process for low-to-moderate income housing in South Kingstown and the wider region and 
opportunities for the Collaborative to create guiding documents / materials. 
 
F. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
 
G. Recurring Discussion Topics: 
 
 1. South County Coalition — Discussion of any relevant updates from the South County Coalition on 
housing topics in the region. 
 
 2. Surplus Town Properties — Discussion of the status of surplus town properties and potential 
advocacy. 
 
 3. Future Public Outreach Activities — Discussion of potential outreach activities, including the 
potential for an Op-Ed in local papers. 
 
H. New Discussion Issues & Future Agenda Items: 
 
I. Adjournment:
